breakdown.description: The grouping criteria are inverted: the no-key case is treated as name-aware, while the key-function case is treated as name-agnostic.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original inverted grouping criteria. It specifies that grouping_without_key_function includes both structure signature AND defect name (name-aware), while grouping_with_key_function ignores the defect name and uses only structure (name-agnostic). This is the opposite of the ground truth, which requires the no-key case to group by structure only (name-agnostic) and the key-function case to group by both structure and name (name-aware).
